Class FakeCoursework

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.services.fake.FakeCoursework
@Component public class FakeCoursework extends Object
Plausible prior coursework for fake applicants (issue #219), built from two data files: the CMPSC prerequisite graph, which gives a believable order to take UCSB courses in, and the computer science courses of a few other universities.

  • Method Details

    • latestQuarter

      public static int latestQuarter(LocalDate today)
      The quarter of the latest course on a fake transcript: the quarter containing today, by the same month rule as the front end (January to March is 1, April to June 2, July and August 3, September to December 4). Summer has no CMPSC courses, so a summer date counts as spring, which makes April to August quarter 2.

    • graduateCourses

    • ucsb

      public List<PriorCoursework> ucsb(Random random, int wanted, int latestQuarter)
      Up to wanted UCSB courses, taken from CMPSC 8 or 16 (chosen by the generator) onward. The walk is a breadth-first traversal of the prerequisite graph in which the next course is chosen at random from the frontier: the courses that list a course already taken as a prerequisite. A course is therefore never taken before one it follows, and fewer than wanted come back when the graph runs out. Terms step forward one quarter per course and end at latestQuarter.
